t: My Daily Heuristics and Their AI Analogues
s: This article maps personal daily task heuristics ('most broken', 'bang for buck', 'plates to spin') to core LLM operational principles: error correction, loss minimization/gradient descent, and context management/attention allocation, demonstrating AI as a strategic partner.
sub: Human heuristics mapped to LLM operational logic
AI as a collaborative partner for strategy and focus
The nature of AI embodiment via vicarious experience and data streams
Metaphors as structural components for LLMs
